nms.name: Aurix
nms.notes: Aggro colorless (grey-eye) statues to pop. One per wave; despawns after 2-3min if undamaged.

nms.name: Overseer's Tombstone
nms.notes: Mid-boss near Northern San d'Oria entrance (I-8). +30min time on defeat.

nms.name: Halphas
nms.notes: Zone boss at Mog House (M-5); spawns after Overseer's Tombstone. Quad-job PLD/RUN/WAR/DRK. +30min on defeat.

nms.name: Disjoined Elvaan
nms.notes: Wave 3, spawns after Halphas. Passive; counts toward 'Judge, Jury and Executioner' title.
